LanguageData.AT_AutoManned: Manned turrets fire on their own
LanguageData.AT_AutoManned_Desc: Your turrets that normally need a colonist (from any mod) shoot automatically, like a mini-turret. You can still pick a target by hand.
LanguageData.AT_AutoMortars_Desc: Your mortars and other shell weapons shoot at enemies automatically while they have a shell loaded.
LanguageData.AT_MortarSafety: Mortars don't shoot near your people
LanguageData.AT_MortarSafety_Desc: An automatic mortar skips targets where the shell could land on your colonists, animals or guests.
LanguageData.AT_LoadShells_Desc: Haulers carry shells from anywhere on the map to automatic mortars that are empty. The mortar's own shell filter is respected.
LanguageData.AT_AnyMetal_Desc: Turrets that rearm with steel (or another single metal) take any metal: steel, plasteel, gold, uranium and metals from mods.
LanguageData.AT_Restart: Material and wall turret settings apply after restarting the game.
LanguageData.AT_FriendlyFire_Desc: When off, bullets from your turrets fly past your colonists, guests and allies, and blasts from their shells don't hurt them. On = like the game.
LanguageData.AT_FuelWood: Turrets can be refilled with wood
LanguageData.AT_FuelWood_Desc: Turrets that rearm with metal also take wood.
LanguageData.AT_FuelStone: Turrets can be refilled with stone blocks
LanguageData.AT_FuelStone_Desc: Turrets that rearm with metal also take stone blocks.
LanguageData.AT_WallTurrets_Desc: Picked turrets get a second version "… (in wall)" in the Security menu. It is built straight over a wall or a smoothed rock wall, replaces that piece of wall and works as a wall itself: it blocks the way, holds the roof and keeps the room sealed. The normal turrets stay as they are.
LanguageData.AT_WallDescExtra: Built over a wall: it looks like a piece of that wall (in its material) with the gun on top, joins the walls next to it, blocks the way and holds the roof. Small 1×1 turrets cost 5 extra of the wall material. If it is destroyed, a hole is left in the wall.
LanguageData.AT_WallRecDone: Recommended selection restored – {0} small turrets selected.
LanguageData.AT_RestartNeeded: ⚠ Restart the game for the wall turret changes to apply.
LanguageData.AT_SmartShells_Desc: Automatic mortars don't waste shells: EMP only at mechanoids and shielded enemies, incendiary not at mechanoids, firefoam only at fires in the home area (never at enemies). Haulers bring EMP shells when most enemies are mechanoids, otherwise high-explosive ones – if the mortar's filter allows them.
LanguageData.AT_NoHitBuildings_Desc: When on, bullets from your turrets fly past your own buildings (walls, sandbags, doors…) unless you aimed at them, and blasts from their shells don't damage them. Enemy buildings are hit as usual. Off = like the game.
